title: World Desk
subtitle: Five thousand years of recorded events, plus a live public-news cache.
disclaimer: This is a desk of major recorded events, not a complete newscast and not a verdict. Religious lifetimes use traditional dates. Live pins are outlet-country coverage, not verified incidents.
